verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Unity ships an editor with an Inspector and extensible Editor Windows/Property Drawers, plus an Asset Database underpinning asset-driven workflows, which supports level-building via a visual UI. However, the pack never explicitly documents the Scene view/viewport or the prefab system that the story specifically calls out. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Scene viewport, prefab workflow, and scene composition tools; independent/hands-on corroboration from technical artists.
